spans.s:
r. 1st. cl. (धनति)
To sound.
r. 3rd cl. (दधन्ति)
To bear or produce, (grain, &c.): restricted to the Vedas.

n. (-नं)
1 Property of any description, thing, substance, wealth.
2 Wealth in cattle, property in herds.
3 A term of endearment.
4 (In Algebra,) The affirmative quantity or plus.
E.
धन to produce, (a crop,) affix अच्.

f. plu. (-नाः)
1 Fried barley or rice. sin.
(-नः)
1 Coriander, (Coriandrum sativum.)
2 Grain fried, and reduced to powder.
3 A bud, a shoot.
E.
धा to nourish, न Uṇādi aff.

m. (-लिः)
KUVERA, the Hindū Plutus; also धनकेलिक.
E.
धन wealth, and केलि who sports.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Purseproud.
E.
धन, and गर्व्वित arrogant.

f. (-च्छूः)
The Numidian crane.
E.
धन the wealth, (of fields,) and च्छो to destroy, affix डू. Note; as a synonym of करेटव्या this word would seem to mean the bird stated: the name itself is more analogous to the Dhanesa of the dialects or the Indian Buceros.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Springing from wealth.
E.
धन, and जात born.

m. (-यः)
1 The deity of fire.
2 A name of

ARJUNA.
3

One of the Nāgas or infernal serpents.
4 One of the five vital airs, that which is supposed to fatten.
5 A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.)
E.
धन wealth, जि to conquer or possess, affix खञ्.

f. (-ष्णा)
Covetousness.
E.
धन, and तृष्णा thirst.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Beneficent, liberal, who gives away property, &c.
m. (-दः)
A name of KUVERA.
E.
धन wealth, देङ्^1 to drink, or दा to give, affix क.
[1] Correction submitted by SergeA on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batche 313.

m. (-ण्डः)
Fine, amercement.
E.
धन, and दण्ड punishment.

m. (-र्पः)
Pride of wealth.
E.
धन, and दर्प pride.

m. (-जः)
RĀVAṆA.
E.
धनद KUVERA, and अनुज younger brother.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Liberal, munificent.
m. (-यी)
1 The deity of fire.
2 A benefactor, a donor.
E.
धन wealth, दा to give, णिनि aff.

f. (-दा)
One of the Śaktis, or female personifications of divine power peculiar to the Bauddhas.
E.
धन wealth, दद to give, affix खश्.

m. (-तिः)
The god of riches, KUVERA.
E.
धन wealth, and पति master or lord.

f. (-का)
Avarice, thirst of wealth.
E.
धन wealth, पिशाचा a she-demon, affix कन्.

f. (-ची)
Extreme desire of riches, avarice.
E.
see the preceding.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Fond of wealth.
f. (-या)
A vegetable, (Ardisia solanacea.)
E.
धन, and प्रिय dear to.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Proud, inflated with the pride of wealth.
E.
धन wealth, मद to be intoxicated, affix अप्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Proceeding from wealth.
n. (-लं)
Principal, capital.
E.
धन, and मूल root.

mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं)
Miserly, avaricious, greedy of wealth, mercenary.
E.
धन, and लुब्ध desirous.

m. (-भः)
Desire of wealth, greediness, avarice.
E.
धन, and लोभ desire.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Wealthy, opulent.
f. (-वती)
The constellation Dhaniṣṭha.
E.
धन wealth, and मतुप् possessive aff.

m. (-यः)
Expenditure, extravagance.
E.
धन, and व्यय expense.

f. (-त्तिः)
Accumulation of wealth.
E.
धन, and सम्पत्ति acquirement.

m. (-सूः)
The fork-tailed shrike.

m. (-कः)
A plant: see गोक्षुर.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
1 Inheriting, an heir.
2 Stealing, a thief.
3 Taking wealth, &c.
f. (-री)
A sort of perfume, commonly called Cor.
E.
धन wealth, हृ to steal, affix अप्, or टच्.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
A thief, a pilferer.
E.
see the last.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
1 Inheriting, an heir.
2 A thief.
E.
धन, and हारिन् who takes.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Poor, reduced to poverty.
E.
धन, and हीन deprived of.

m. (-मः)
Accession of wealth.
E.
धन, and आगम coming.

n. (-नं)
Acceptance of money.
E.
धन, and आदान taking.

mf. (-री-रिणी)
An heir, an heiress.
m. (-रिः)
A treasurer, a collector.
E.
धन, and अधिकारिन् having a right to.

m. (-तः)
A treasurer.
E.
धन, and अधिकृत placed over.

m. (-पः)
1 A name of

KUVERA.
2

A treasurer.
E.
धन riches, and अधिप lord; also similar compounds, धनाधिपति, &c.

m. (-क्षः)
1 A name of

KUVERA.
2

A treasurer.
E.
धन wealth, अध्यक्ष superintendent.

m. (-रः)
1 Fine, amercement.
2 Plunder.
E.
धन, and अपहार taking away.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Wealthy, opulent.
E.
धन, and अर्च्चित respected by.

n. (-नं)
Acquisition of property.
E.
धन, and अर्ज्जन acquiring.

mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि)
Seeking for wealth, covetous, miserly.
E.
धन, and अर्थिन् who wants.

f. (-शा)
Thirst of wealth, longing after riches.
E.
धन wealth, आशा hope, wish.

f. (-श्रीः)
One of the Rāgiṇīs.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Pious, virtuous, excellent.
2 Rich, opulent.
m. (-कः)
1 A wealthy man.
2 A creditor.
3 A husband.
4 Coriander.
f. (-का)
1 A virtuous or excellent woman.
2 A wife.
3 A young woman.
4 A tree: see प्रियङ्गु.
E.
धन wealth, affix ठक्.

f. (-का)
A young woman.
E.
धन wealth, ठक् affix, and the vowel made long.

mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि)
Wealthy, opulent.
m. (-नी)
1 A rich man.
2 A creditor.
E.
धन wealth, इनि aff.

f. (-ष्ठा)
The twenty-fourth Nakṣatra or lunar mansion; it comprises four stars, apparently α β γ and δ Delphini, and is figured by a drum or tabor.
E.
धन to produce, (as corn,) affix अच् and मतुप् added, धनवत् again, इष्ठन् added, and मतुप् rejected, fem. affix टाप्.

n. (-कं)
Coriander seed.
E.
धन to be produced, (as corn,) affix छ, and कन् added: see धन्याक.

m. (-नुः)
1 A bow.
2 The sign

Sagittarius.
3

A tree: see प्रियाल.
4 A measure of four cubits.
E.
धन here meaning to cast as an arrow, Uṇādi affix उ; also धनुस्.

m. (-नूः)
A bow: see the last.

n. (-ण्डं)
A bow and arrow.
E.
धनुस्, and काण्ड an arrow.

n. (-ण्डं)
A bow, the stick or horns of the bow.
E.
धनुस्, and खण्ड a part.

m. (-टः)
The Piyal tree, (Buchanania latifolia, Rox.)
E.
धनुस् a bow, and पट width; bending like a bow.

f. (-खा)
A plant, from the leaves of which a tough thread is extracted, of which bow strings were formerly made: see मूर्व्वा, (Sanseviera zeylanica, Rox. but called by Sir WM. JONES, Aletris hyacinthoides.)
E.
धनुस् a bow, शाखा a branch.

f. (-णी)
A plant: see the last.
E.
धनुस् a bow, and श्रेणी a line.

mf. (-णः-णा)
A bow string.
f. (-णा)
A plant, from which bow strings are made: see the two last.
E.
धनुस् a bow, and गुण a string.

m. (-मः)
A bambu.
E.
धनुस्, and द्रुम a tree.

m. (-रः)
An archer, a bowyer, one armed with a bow.
E.
धनुस् a bow, and धर who possesses.

m. (-री)
An archer, a bowyer.
E.
धनुस्, and धारिन् who has.

m. (-त्)
An archer.
E.
धनुस् a bow, and भृत् who possesses: see the last.

n. (-ध्यं)
The middle part of a bow.
E.
धनुस् a bow, मध्य the centre.

n. (-र्गं)
A curve line.
E.
धनुस् an are, and मार्ग a road.

f. (-ला)
A plant, from the leaves of which bow strings were made: see मूर्व्वा.
E.
धनुस् a bow, and माला a garland.

m. (-सः)
A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.)
E.
धनुस् for धन्वन् a dry soil, and यास here said to mean effort; also धन्वयास.

f. (-ता)
The moon plant.

m. (-क्षः)
1 A plant; also called

Dhāminiya.
2

A bambu.
3 A measure of four cubits.
4 An are, a portion of the circumference of a circle.
E.
धनुस् a bow, and वृक्ष a tree.

m. (-रः)
A bowyer, an archer.
E.
धनुस् a bow, and कर who makes or practices.

m. (-टः)
A tree: see धनुःपट.
E.
धनुस् a bow, पट breadth.

mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि)
Armed with a bow.
m. (-णिः)
An archer.
E.
धमुस्, and पाणि hand.

m. (-ष्मान्)
An archer, a bowyer.
E.
धनुस् a bow, मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-नुः-नुः-नु)
Armed with a bow.
mn. (-नुः-नु)
1 A bow.
2 Sagittarius, the sign.
m. (-नुः)
The Piyal tree, (Buchanania latifolia, Rox.)
E.
धन to produce, (as grain,) to throw forth, (darts, &c.) Uṇādi affix उसि; also with उ affix धनु, and with ऊ affix, धनू.

n. (-कं)
Coriander: see धन्याक.
E.
धन grain, ढक् affix, and कन् added.

m. (-शः)
KUVERA.
E.
धन, and ईश lord.

m. (-रः)
KUVERA, the Hindū PLUTUS.
E.
धन wealth, ईश्वर lord.

mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि)
Wishing or claiming property.
m. (-षी)
A creditor.
E.
धन, and ऐषिन् who wishes.

m. (-यः)
Accumulation of wealth.
E.
धन, and उपचय assembling.

mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं)
1 Fortunate, well fated, lucky.
2 Good, virtuous.
m. (-न्यः)
1 An infidel, an atheist.
2 A virtuous or fortunate man.
f. (-न्या)
1 Emblic myrobalan.
2 A nurse.
3 Coriander.
n. (-न्यं)
Wealth.
E.
धन to produce, (grain, &c.) or धन wealth, and यत् affix of fitness.

n. (-न्यं)
1 Corn in general, but especially rice, (Oriza sativa.)
2

Coriander.
3

A measure equal to four Sesamum seeds.
E.
धा to nourish (mankind), Uṇādi affix यत्, and नुट् augment.

n. (-त्वं)
Luck, good fortune.
E.
धन्य, and त्व affix; also with तल् affix धन्यता.

n. (-कं)
A plant, bearing a small pungent seed used by the Hindus as a condiment, (Coriandrum sativum.)
E.
धन to produce, (as grain,) deriv. irr.

n. (-कं)
Coriander, (C. sativum.)
E.
कन् added to धान्य; also धन्याक and धान्याक.

n. (-कं)
Coriander.
E.
अण् added to धन्याक.

n. (-न्वं)
A bow: see धन्वन्.

n. (-र्गं)
A desart.
E.
धन्व the same, and दुर्ग strong, hold.

mn. (-न्वा-न्व)
A bow.
m. (-न्वा)
A country scantily supplied with water, a desart, a waste.
n. (-न्व)
A firm spot, land, ground.
E.
धन्वि Sautra root, to go or move, (by or on which,) and कनिन् Uṇādi affix; also with अच् affix धन्व.

m. (-नः)
A medicinal plant, commonly called Dhāminiya or Dhamin.

m. (-रिः)
1 The physician of the gods, who was produced at the churning of the ocean.
2 A celebrated physician; also काशिराज being the same as the preceding in another existence: he appears to have been the founder of the Hindu medical school.
3 The sun.
4 A name of Ś

IVA.
5
One of the nine gems of the court of VIKRAMĀDITYA.

f. (-स्ता)
A medicinal plant: see कटुकी.
E.
धन्वन्तारि, and ग्रस्त eaten.

m. (-सः)
A plant, (Hedysarum alhaji.)
E.
धन्व dry soil, यु to unite, आसच् affix; also with कन् added धन्वयवासक.

m. (-सः)
A plant: see the last; also simply यास, &c.

m. (-न्वी)
1 An archer, a bow-man.
2 A name of

ARJUNA.
3

A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.)
4 A wag, a wit, a sharp or shrewd man.
E.
धन्व a bow, इनि aff.

f. plu. (-काः)
Fried barley or rice.
E.
धाना as above, कन् added.

n. (-र्णं)
The meal or flour of fried barley, rice, &c.
E.
धाना fried grain, चूर्ण powder, dust.

Coriander.
2

A granary, a receptacle.
3 The site of a habitation.
4 The name of a river.
5 What has or contains, used in composition, as राजधानी a royal capital, having the king's presence; मत्स्यधानी a net, &c.
E.
धा to have, affix युच्, fem. affix ङीप्.

m. (-ष्कः)
A bowyer, an archer.
E.
धनुस् a bow, ठञ् affix.
f. (-ष्का)
A tree, (Achyranthes aspera).
E.
धनुष्क an archer, अण् affix, and fem. affix टाप्, or धनुस् a bow, ठन् aff.

m. (-ष्यः)
A bambu.
E.
धनुस् as above, यञ् aff.

n. (-यः)
Coriander, (Coriandrum sativum.)
E.
धन grain, &c. aff. ढक्; also with कन् added, धानेयक.

f. (-न्धा)
Small cardamoms.

n. (-ल्कं)
Bran, chaff, straw.
E.
धान्य, and कल्क dirt or sediment.

n. (-कं)
A granary, a basket, a cupboard or small shed of matting, &c. for keeping rice.
E.
धान्य rice, कोष्ठ a granary, and कन् added.

m. (-सः)
Rice flattened by threshing after it has been steeped, and fried in the husk.
E.
धान्य grain, and चमस a sort of cake.

f. (-नुः)
A heap of rice to be presented to Brahmans.
E.
धान्य, and धेनु a cow.

m. (-यः)
A corn-seller, &c.
E.
धान्य grain, मा to measure, अण् aff.

m. (-जः)
Barley.
E.
धान्य, and राजा king.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Abounding in corn, having abundance of it.
E.
धान्य, and मतुप् poss. aff.

n. (-नं)
Lending grain at interest; receiving a usurious return for a loan of seed corn supplied to the peasants.
E.
धान्य corn, वर्द्धन increasing.

n. (-जं)
Coriander.
E.
धान्य, and वीज seed.

m. (-रः)
A sort of pulse, (Phaseolus max.)
E.
धान्य, and वीर best.

n. (-कं)
The ear or spike of corn.
E.
धान्य, with शीर्षक the top or head.

m. (-हः)
A store or magazine of grain.
E.
धान्य, and सङ्ग्रह collection.

m. (-रः)
Grain after threshing.
E.
धान्य corn, and सार essence.

m. (-लः)
A pile of grain for presentation to Brahmans.
E.
धान्य, and अचल a mountain.

n. (-म्लं)
Sour gruel made of the fermentation of rice water.
E.
धान्य rice, and अम्ल sour.

m. (-रिः)
A rat.
E.
धान्य, and अरि a foe.

m. (-र्थः)
Wealth in rice or grain.
E.
धान्य, and अर्थ wealth.

n. (-स्थि)
Grain after threshing.
E.
धान्य, and अस्थि a bone.

n. (-मं)
Rice.
E.
धान्य, and उत्तम best.
